title: Integrability of the deviation of the Radon–Nikodym density from one
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $ rac{d\mu}{d
u} : \Omega 	o  br$ be the real-valued Radon–Nikodym density of $\mu$ with respect to $
u$ (the extended nonnegative Radon–Nikodym derivative converted to a real number). Then the function $x \mapsto \abs{ rac{d\mu}{d
u}(x) - 1}$ is integrable with respect to $
u$.
replaced:
The function $x \mapsto |\mathrm{rnDensity}(\mu,\nu)(x) - 1|$ is integrable with
respect to $\nu$.
